# UI asset notices

Status: Active
Last reviewed: 9 November 2026

## Public Sans

PublicSans-Regular.woff2 and PublicSans-SemiBold.woff2 are unmodified webfonts
from the [Public Sans project](https://github.com/uswds/public-sans).
The files remain subject to SIL Open Font License 1.1. Preserve
LICENSE-PublicSans-OFL.txt and LICENSE-PublicSans-notice.md with redistributed
font files. The notice explains the underlying Libre Franklin and GSA work.

## Commit Mono

commit-mono-400-regular.woff is an unmodified webfont from the
[official LiveKit React starter](https://github.com/livekit-examples/agent-starter-react).
The [original Commit Mono project](https://github.com/eigilnikolajsen/commit-mono)
is MIT licensed. Preserve LICENSE-CommitMono-MIT.txt and LICENSE-LiveKit-MIT.txt.
The original published WOFF is retained without conversion.

## LiveKit symbol

lk-logo.svg and lk-logo-dark.svg are official symbol SVG assets (trailing whitespace normalized) from the
[official LiveKit React starter](https://github.com/livekit-examples/agent-starter-react).
Preserve LICENSE-LiveKit-MIT.txt. Use the symbol to identify LiveKit integration;
the ecosystem retains its own product identity and makes no affiliation claim.
The [brand guidance](https://livekit.com/brand) supplies colors and usage context.

## Provenance

asset-sources.json records public source URLs, retrieval date and file sizes.
Only trailing whitespace in the SVG files and OFL notice was normalized; graphics
and license wording are unchanged.
Assets are served locally; no font CDN is required at runtime. The bundle includes
no Everett font, generated logos or third-party proprietary brand assets.
